title: Maybe? lehet and Being Free: ráér

sections.content: lehet is an impersonal word meaning 'it's possible / it may be' -- it's often used alone to ask or confirm whether a suggestion works. ráér ('to be free/have time') is a regular verb: ráérek ('I'm free').
lehet needs no subject and never changes form -- it simply floats in front of whatever is being proposed. As a one-word answer, 'Igen, lehet' means 'Yes, that's possible/fine.'
